editorial.headline: Islamic Preschool Education: Nationally Open, Address-Sensitive in Bali
editorial.standfirst: This activity covers Islamic preschool education for children aged four to six, and is nationally open to foreign ownership while requiring address-level verification in Bali.
editorial.body:
Islamic preschool education under this activity is education for children aged four to six that integrates Islamic values into preparation for primary schooling. Its setting is formative rather than incidental: children are introduced to worship practices, prayer memorisation and understanding of the Qur’an as part of early learning. The scope expressly includes Qur’an-focused early-childhood education, *raudhatul athfal* and *bustanul athfal*.

That definition gives the activity its centre of gravity. It is not simply a general preschool with occasional religious content, but an early-years educational offering in which Islamic learning is integrated into the programme of preparation for basic education. The record does not list any eligible business scales, so it offers no basis for inferring a scale category beyond the activity itself.

Nationally, the PMA position is clear: the activity is open, with a foreign-ownership ceiling of 100%. The cited basis is Perpres 10/2021 and 49/2021. In other words, the national record does not place a foreign-share cap below full ownership for this activity. That national openness is the starting point for any foreign-owned registration assessment, not a substitute for reading the local position accurately.

Bali does not mark this activity as blocked for PMA registration under its island-wide moratorium. The provincial rule blocks all Low and Medium-Low risk activities for PMA, while this activity is recorded as Medium-High or High risk and therefore outside that blanket block. The Bali entry still calls for verification by address. For a prospective operator, that is the precise local conclusion: the activity is not subject to the moratorium’s blanket PMA prohibition, but its treatment must be checked for the particular address.
